releaseNotes: Release v27 - Version 4.9: Enhanced Genesis Payload Sync & Robust Reverse-MCP Async Protocol. Features multi-chunk carrier-safe Genesis manifest segmentation, release-aware dynamic catalog hashing (REL-2026-09-11-v4), explicit AI receipt acknowledgement and verification, and resilient in-app update management.

Release v25 - Version 4.7: High-Leverage Cellular & State Guardians. Features FuzzyStreamDemuxer self-repairing JSON stream recovery, LocalHealerAgent on-device math and formula sanitization, GSM-7 Wire Tariff Normalizer and real-time PDU byte badge, AtomicStateMutex with LMK SQLite checkpointing across process lifecycle, and RDP VectorCurveDecimator for 85% canvas stroke optimization.

Release v24 - Version 4.6: Cellular Telephony Ingestion & Hybrid Scripting Engine. HardenedTelephonyObserverService dual reactive SMS/MMS content observers, multi-part segment reassembly with 1200ms debounce, HardenedMmsParser with 3-stage backoff and PduHeaders.FROM resolution, onResume missed-message delta reconciliation, sub-50ms sandboxed JS/arithmetic execution (SimpleMathParser & JavaScriptSandbox), and native SDUI selection components. (Optimized binary 29.9 MB)

Release v23 - Version 4.4: Self-Contained Edge Execution & Zero-Network Canvas Hardening. 100% on-device continuous 120Hz vector canvas drawing with CanvasStrokeStore recomposition memory and offline snapshot saving, carrier-safe unpadded Base64/GZIP cellular decompression in DualResponseParser, automated WCAG 2.2 AA contrast guardian in ChatThemeConfig, and Android 12/13/14 exact alarm permission safety fallbacks. (Optimized binary 29.1 MB)

Release v22 - Version 4.2: Cellular Voice MMS Pipeline & Ingestion/Transmission Hardening. Adaptive AMR-WB voice compression, hardware SMS_SENT and SMS_DELIVERED PendingIntent callbacks, resilient in-flight Room outbox state machine, and 3-stage adaptive MMSC download polling. (Optimized binary 28.5 MB)
Release v19 - Differential Mini-App Patching (OTA Deltas) with RFC 6902 JsonPatchEngine and Transport Fallback Orchestrator.
